evening.title: Evening Menu
evening.intro: Our cheeses are carefully selected from award-winning Rennet & Rind. Our charcuterie comes from Sunday Charcuterie, known for 100% British cured meats. Both are best enjoyed with good bread, perhaps some olives, and naturally, a lovely glass of wine.
evening.introNote: All plates are designed for one, or can be shared between two for a smaller bite.
